entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-24
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11423.137 #82138

Updated

  • SuppressMessage doesn't work on lambdas #59746
    Backlog
  • Severe SemanticModel performance regression with Roslyn 5.0 vs 4.14 - 4x slower #81815
    18.4
  • Test plan for "Unsafe Evolution" #81207
    .NET 11
  • Generalize `(CollectionBuilderType<T>)[..readOnlySpan]` optimization to spread operands which are implicitly convertible to `ReadOnlySpan<T>` #73110
    Backlog
  • Go to definition (or implementation) not working as expected on Visual Studio 2026 #81510

PullRequests

Created

  • Improve elimination of redundant evaluations during pattern matching operation #82142
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Pattern Matching
  • Fix SuppressMessage attribute not working on lambda expressions #82140
  • Reduce allocations during analysis result creation. #82139
    Area-Analyzers

Updated

  • Support marking generated public APIs as experimental #82131
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: handle remaining member kinds #82043
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • MakeFinalIVTDetermination: Cache AssemblyIdentity instead of AssemblySymbol #82132
    Area-Compilers
  • Better codegen for record's `Equals` member #79966
    Area-Compilers, Community, Code Gen Quality
  • Extensions: Optimize GetExtensionMembers #82124
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Reduce allocations in LSP completion handling. #82133
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Change VS to ensure that LSP completions are sorted as intended. #82134
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Validate generator diagnostics after incremental updates #82113
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix a crash involving `[SetsRequiredMembers]` and required property using field keyword on a base type #82136
    Area-Compilers
  • Add more details to stale project update warning #82053
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • [WIP] Add TargetFramework property to Project #82102
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix Call Hierarchy cross-thread exception when displaying field initializers #82127
    Area-IDE
  • Fix NuGet package search by restoring fallback #82129
    Area-IDE
  • Refactor attribute filtering in PE symbols #82118
    Area-Compilers
